newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish m/m Oct CPI 1.2-1.3 pct, yr/yr 18.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Polish m/m Oct CPI 1.2-1.3 pct, yr/yr 18.8 pct.

text.p: Polish inflation was between 1.2 and 1.3 percent in October, which, if the lower figure is more accurate, would take the year-on-year index down to 18.8 percent from 19.5 percent in September, the finance minister said.
Grzegorz Kolodko told Reuters during a break in a Senate committee meeting that the finance ministry expected consumer prices to grow 0.9 percent in November.

"The consumer price index rose by about 1.2-1.3 percent in October," Kolodko said. "The lower month-on-month figure, which I hope is more accurate, would take the year-on-year index down to 18.8 percent," he said.

The government initially expected to bring down inflation to 17 percent in year-on-year terms in December 1996 from 21.6 percent in December 1995, but has recently revised its forecast to 17.8 percent.
